placement.claim: A proposal-review coordination capability is the immediate candidate, but evidence has not resolved whether selection and synthesis share one owner or whether the capability belongs to a shared cross-phase review substrate.

reopening_conditions: Dogfooding shows that panel selection and synthesis require different independence or information lifetimes.
A specialist registry needs mechanically governed capability metadata rather than an open judgment surface.
Implementation review establishes a primary shared consumer whose boundary conflicts with proposal-local coordination.
Deterministic evidence proves sufficient for representative proposals without model specialist review.

authority.decision_owner: user or future explicitly authorized portfolio owner

relationships.rationale: Adaptive panel coordination needs revision-bound artifact semantics so specialist findings and synthesis retain exact subject identity, provenance, applicability, and non-authoritative status.
